lines.v01: Nineteen thirty seven. Shanghai is burning. Within four years, the whole world will be at war.
lines.v02: This is Bitz-kreeg. Iron Front, forty-four.
lines.v03: Eighty-two real battles, in thirteen campaigns. From the beaches of Normandy, to the ruins of Stalingrad. From the mountains of Eritrea, to the carriers of the Pacific.
lines.v04: Every turn is yours to command. Choose your ground. Move your armour. And know the odds, before you strike.
lines.v05: Then watch it play out. Every shell. Every torpedo. Every man.
lines.v06: These are the real armies, under the real generals. Each with their own strengths, and their own fate.
lines.v07: Before every battle, the history. After it, what really happened, to the war, and to the men who fought it.
lines.v08: Win, and your veterans fight on into the next battle. Lose them, and they are gone.
lines.v09: Hold the line in Last Stand. Build your own battlefields. Take on a friend.
lines.v10: And when night falls, the dead rise.
lines.v11: Bitz-kreeg. Iron Front, forty-four. Free to play, in your browser.
